Bundled OpenSSL is assembled in-tree from vendored inputs: the official OpenSSL upstream tree is tracked as the git submodule at openssl-src (pin the tag in .gitmodules / submodule commit), and the Fsu0413 openssl-externalCMake wrapper is committed under wrapper/ (without the nested openssl/ checkout). Run cmake -P scripts/bootstrap_openssl_bundle.cmake from the repository root to refresh deps/openssl/vendored/bundle/ (Configure/build_generated, patches, and pregenerated param-name artifacts); the main RetDec configure step does not download sources when that bundle already exists.
